name: tree-public-proteingym-sequence-evolution-veto
hypothesis: Extend the sequence/evolution/structure mean with a consensus failure leaf: ESM2 below -15 AND GEMME below -10 yields zero. Joint language-model and evolutionary evidence of a damaging variant may justify deprioritizing it despite a favorable inverse-folding score. These are rounded poor-score regimes observed without labels, fixed identically for ProteinGym and its MegaScale subset; no sweep.
